task.goal: 把陌生人塞来的硬盘处理掉，让夜班回到平静
task.obstacle: 来人一句明天有人来拿，老陈伸手要拿
task.stake: 收下就卷进去，交出去可能害到老陈

change: 硬盘从陌生人手里到了小夏的抽屉里，老陈从常客变成知情人。
hook: 陌生人塞过来的硬盘里到底是什么——冷开场第一拍就是雨衣男把袋子塞进小夏手里
cliff: 老陈没看见门口，却知道那人穿雨衣；风铃响了一声，门外只有雨

flow.action: 雨夜的便利店门口，林小夏拎着垃圾袋刚推开门，一个穿雨衣的男人就把一个防静电袋塞进她手里。

flow.speaker: C03
flow.line: 帮我收着。明天有人来拿。

flow.action: 男人没回头，走进雨里，雨衣很快和夜色融在一起。
林小夏低头，隔着袋子摸出一块硬盘的形状。
林小夏回到收银台，把防静电袋放在台面上。
老陈端着一碗关东煮从货架后面走过来，在收银台前坐下。

flow.speaker: C01
flow.line: 陈叔，你怎么天天半夜来。
flow.delivery: 顺口一问，眼睛还在袋子上

flow.action: 老陈的目光落在防静电袋上，筷子停了一下。

flow.speaker: C01
flow.line: 刚才一个人放这儿的，说明天有人来拿。

flow.action: 老陈把碗放下，伸手想拿袋子，林小夏先一步把袋子收进红色抽屉。
林小夏抬头，老陈已经站起来，看着门外的雨。

flow.speaker: C02
flow.line: 三年前，这店里丢过一样东西。

flow.action: 他转过身，第一次正眼看林小夏。
林小夏低头看抽屉，抽屉缝里露出袋子一角，老陈的碗还在冒热气。

flow.speaker: VO
flow.line: 他怎么知道那人穿雨衣。

flow.action: 门口的风铃突然响了一声，两人同时转头，门外只有雨。

visualPlans.rhythm: locked off through the ritual, one push on his eyes, one push on the question, one pan on the turn, locked again for the cliff
visualPlans.landing: two heads turned to an empty door and a man who keeps his eyes on it
visualPlans.sound: oden warmer and fluorescent buzz under everything; the drawer slam and the single chime are the two loud things; the cello only under the last two lines

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, cool blue-grey palette. The cold open follows @image1: under a dripping striped awning in heavy night rain, a young night-shift clerk in a faded navy jacket steps out of the glass door with a trash bag as a tall man in a black hooded raincoat presses a silver anti-static bag into her free hand; a tracking shot follows her from the doorway as the bag lands in her hand.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to the close-up of @image2: a static shot holds on the hooded man's stubbled jaw, and the man in the hooded raincoat, speaking in @audio1, hushed and fast with almost no pauses, flat and nasal, barely above a whisper, says without looking at her: <d>[Chinese] 帮我收着。明天有人来拿。</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to @image3: a slow push in toward the clerk's face as she clutches the bag to her chest, and the young woman in the navy jacket, speaking in @audio2, quiet and slightly fast, clipping the ends of phrases, flat and guarded, calls after him: <d>[Chinese] 你是谁？我们不代收——</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to the wide framing of @image4: a static shot from the lit doorway as the man walks away without turning, his black raincoat dissolving into the rain and darkness past the puddles.
[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to @image5: a slow push in on her hands as her fingers press the translucent bag and the rectangular outline of a hard drive shows through the plastic.

overall_soundscape: All dialogue in standard Mandarin. Heavy rain drumming on the fabric awning and splashing in the puddles, the glass door hissing shut behind her, wet footsteps receding into the street, the faint crackle of plastic as her fingers press the bag. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen dialogue text.
